[b]Content Patcher Installation Instructions[/b]
[list]
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ 
[*]Download "Content Patcher - Scoot Duck Replacer
[*]Extract "Scoot Animal Crossing Duck Replacer by CHlPPER" zip file
[*]Move the new folder to programfiles> steam> steamapps> common> stardew valley> mods
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI and then you're done!
[/list]
[b]Original Post: May 30, 2018[/b]
I've recently got into modding Stardew Valley so I decided to reskin the duck texture to look like Scoot from Animal Crossing! :)
This is just the .xnb file so you'll have to go to your Stardew Valley folder and go into content/animals and paste the file in there.
Be sure to make a backup the original duck.xnb file if you'd like to have the vanilla duck again!

If you would like to include this mod along with your own please let me know and please credit me if you do so.
It's easiest to contact me through Discord at CHIPPER#0001 or if I happen to change my username I also have a small Discord Server to showcase my mods
